name: eCoin pivotal study
aliases: Leadless tibial nerve stimulator pivotal study
question: What proportion of adults with refractory urgency urinary incontinence responded to implanted eCoin tibial nerve stimulation after 48 weeks of therapy?

arms.label: eCoin leadless implantable tibial nerve stimulator

design.population: 137 adults with refractory urgency urinary incontinence were enrolled at 15 US centers; 133 received an implant and 132 entered the published intention-to-treat analysis after one participant with zero baseline UUI episodes was excluded.
design.description: Prospective, multicenter, open-label, single-arm pivotal device study
design.locator: Full text, Results, p 404; Table 1, p 403

verdictNote: Primary efficacy met the prespecified 40% performance goal in a single-arm ITT analysis.
takeaway: In this single-arm pivotal study, 68% of the 132-person published ITT set responded at 48 weeks after activation (95% CI 60%–76%), meeting the prespecified 40% performance goal; device-related events affected 16% of 133 implanted participants through 52 weeks.

reports.label: 48-week pivotal report
reports.citation: Rogers A, Bragg S, Ferrante K, et al. "Pivotal Study of Leadless Tibial Nerve Stimulation with eCoin® for Urgency Urinary Incontinence: An Open-Label, Single Arm Trial." *J Urol.* 2021;206(2):399-408. doi:10.1097/JU.0000000000001733
reports.followUp: 48 weeks after activation for efficacy; 52 weeks after implantation for device-related adverse events
reports.followUpLocator: Full text, Outcomes, p 402; Results, p 406

results.measure: At least 50% fewer urgency urinary incontinence episodes at 48 weeks after activation; published intention-to-treat population (n=132)
results.note: Prespecified success required the lower bound of the two-sided 95% CI to exceed the 40% performance goal; the paper does not print a primary-endpoint P value.
results.locator: Full text, Statistical Analysis and Results, p 404

results.endpoint: Mean change in daily urgency urinary incontinence episodes
results.measure: Change from baseline at 48 weeks after activation among 120 with available three-day diaries; no imputation for secondary outcomes

results.endpoint: Overactive Bladder Questionnaire quality of life
results.measure: Mean changes from baseline at 48 weeks after activation among 116 with available questionnaire data; no imputation

values.exp: Symptom bother -34.2 (SD 27.5; n=116; P < 0.001); health-related quality of life +34.5 (SD 25.9; n=116; P < 0.001)

harms.label: Device-related adverse events through 52 weeks after implantation
harms.locator: Full text, Abstract and Results, pp 400, 406
harms.note: The FDA physician labeling uses a different device-related event count.

harms.label: Device- or procedure-related adverse events through 52 weeks, journal analysis

values.exp: 26/133 (20%): mild 15/133 (11%), moderate 8/133 (6%), severe 3/133 (2%); infections 9/133 (7%), including postoperative wound infection 6/133 (5%); device stimulation issues 6/133 (5%) and device dislocation 2/133 (2%)

harms.note: Table 5 gives patient counts by MedDRA severity; the paper's prose rounds the overall rate to 19%.

harms.label: Serious device- or procedure-related adverse event through 52 weeks, journal analysis

values.exp: 1/133 (1%): procedure-related infection requiring explantation, resolved without sequelae

harms.label: Device- or procedure-related adverse events through 52 weeks, FDA labeling analysis
harms.locator: FDA physician labeling P200036D, p32, Table 2
harms.note: This broader event category is from FDA labeling, not the journal abstract.

harms.label: Serious device- or procedure-related adverse events, FDA labeling analysis
harms.locator: FDA physician labeling P200036D, p32, Tables 2-3
harms.note: Three infections and one contact dermatitis led to explantation.

delivery.label: Implant location and treatment delivery
delivery.value: eCoin was implanted subcutaneously in the medial lower leg above the fascia over the tibial nerve and delivered automated stimulation sessions; programming used 20 pulses/second, 200-microsecond pulse width and 0.5–15 mA amplitude adjusted to an acceptable sensory level.

delivery.label: Implantation time
delivery.value: Mean incision-to-final-suture time was 19.8 minutes (SD 14.3) under local anesthesia.

delivery.label: Procedure setting and activation
delivery.value: Implantation was performed in office or outpatient settings under local anesthesia; activation followed a 4-week healing period, then 30-minute sessions every 3 days for 18 weeks and every 4 days thereafter.
delivery.note: The journal describes office or outpatient implantation and four-week activation.
